NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 2 OF 1974 Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 2 of 1974, I, Anura Karunathilaka, Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing, do hereby approve the acquisition of the immovable properties of the allotment of land described in the following schedule as it is required by the said Board to acquire an additional land, for the construction of Keppetipola Water Treatment Plant under Keppetipola Water Supply Scheme.
Anura Karunathilaka (M.P), Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing.
Ref. No. : MUDH/WS/LA/04/556,Ministry of Urban Development, Construction and Housing,12th Floor,Sethsiripaya Stage II,Battaramulla,30th June, 2025.
